209 int32_t HWAutil_configCFAR(HWA_Handle handle,
210  uint8_t paramSetStartIdx,
211  uint32_t numRangeBins,
212  uint32_t numDopplerBins,
213  DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg *cfarCfg,
214  uint16_t detObjectListSize,
215  uint8_t dmaTriggerSource,
216  uint32_t hwaSourceBufOffset,
217  uint32_t hwaDestBufOffset,
218  uint8_t cfarDomain)
219 {
220  HWA_ParamConfig hwaParamCfg;
221  int32_t retVal = 0;
222 
223  retVal = HWA_enable(handle, 0); // Disable HWA
224  if (retVal != 0)
225  {
226  goto exit;
227  }
228 
229 
230  (void)memset( (void*) &hwaParamCfg, 0, sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
231  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
232  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = dmaTriggerSource;
233 
234  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.peakGroupEn = cfarCfg->peakGroupingEn;
235  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_CFAR;
236 
237  //cfarInpMode = 1, cfarLogMode = 1, cfarAbsMode = 00b
238  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.operMode = HWA_CFAR_OPER_MODE_LOG_INPUT_REAL;
239 
240  if(cfarDomain == DPU_CFAR_RANGE_DOMAIN)
241  {
242  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = (uint16_t)numRangeBins - 1U;
243  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)numDopplerBins*(int32_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
244  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
245  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)numDopplerBins - 1U;
246  }
247  else
248  {
249  if (cfarCfg->cyclicMode == 1U)
250  {
251  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = ((uint16_t)numDopplerBins - 1U) + ((uint16_t)cfarCfg->guardLen + (uint16_t)cfarCfg->winLen) * 2U;
252  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShift = (uint16_t)numDopplerBins - ((uint16_t)cfarCfg->guardLen + (uint16_t)cfarCfg->winLen);
253  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShiftWrap = mathUtils_floorLog2(numDopplerBins);
254  hwaParamCfg.source.srcCircShiftWrap3 = 0;
255  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcircShift = 0;
256  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcircShiftWrap = 0;
257  }
258  else
259  {
260  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = (uint16_t)numDopplerBins - 1U;
261  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShift = 0;
262  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShiftWrap = 0;
263  }
264 
265  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
266  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)numDopplerBins*(int32_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
267  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)numRangeBins - 1U;
268  }/* DOPPLER DOMAIN */
269 
270  hwaParamCfg.source.srcRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_REAL;
271  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = hwaSourceBufOffset;
272  hwaParamCfg.source.srcScale = 8;
273 
274  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = hwaDestBufOffset;
275  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAcnt = (uint16_t)detObjectListSize - 1U;
276  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_COMPLEX;
277  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_32BIT;
278  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput);
279  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = 0; //don't care
280  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstScale = 8;
281 
282  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numGuardCells = cfarCfg->guardLen;
283  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.nAvgDivFactor = cfarCfg->noiseDivShift;//not applicable in CFAR_OS
284  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cyclicModeEn = cfarCfg->cyclicMode;
285  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.nAvgMode = cfarCfg->averageMode;
286  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numNoiseSamplesRight = cfarCfg->winLen >> 1;
287  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numNoiseSamplesLeft = cfarCfg->winLen >> 1;
288  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.outputMode = HWA_CFAR_OUTPUT_MODE_I_PEAK_IDX_Q_NEIGHBOR_NOISE_VAL;
289 
290  if (cfarCfg->averageMode == HWA_NOISE_AVG_MODE_CFAR_OS)
291  {
292  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cfarOsKvalue = cfarCfg->osKvalue;
293  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cfarOsEdgeKScaleEn = cfarCfg->osEdgeKscaleEn;
294  }
295 
296  retVal = HWA_configParamSet(handle, paramSetStartIdx, &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
297  if (retVal != 0)
298  {
299  goto exit;
300  }
301 
302  /* Disable trigger DMA/interrupt for this param set */
303  retVal = HWA_disableParamSetInterrupt(handle,
304  paramSetStartIdx,
305  HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA | HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_CPU_INTR1);
306 
307 
308 exit:
309  return (retVal);
310 }

328 int32_t CFARHWA_config_EDMA
329 (
330  HWA_Handle hwaHandle,
331  DPU_CFARProcHWA_HW_Resources *pRes,
332  DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig *staticCfg
333 )
334 {
335  int32_t errorCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
336  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
337  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg chainingCfg;
338 
339  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t)pRes->edmaHwaInSignature.channel;
340  chainingCfg.isIntermediateChainingEnabled = false;
341  chainingCfg.isFinalChainingEnabled = true;
342 
343  syncABCfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)pRes->detMatrix.data;
344  syncABCfg.destAddress = (uint32_t)pRes->hwaMemInp;
345 
346  /*input data can be 1024*32*2=65536 bytes, aCount uint16_t max at 65535, so do 2 transfers.*/
347  syncABCfg.aCount = staticCfg->numRangeBins * staticCfg->numDopplerBins;
348  syncABCfg.bCount = (uint16_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
349  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t)(syncABCfg.aCount);
350  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t)(syncABCfg.aCount);
351  syncABCfg.cCount = 1U;
352  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = 0;
353  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = 0;
354 
355  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(pRes->edmaHandle,
356  &pRes->edmaHwaIn,
357  &chainingCfg,
358  &syncABCfg,
359  false, //isEventTriggered
360  false,//isIntermediateTransferInterruptEnabled
361  false,//isTransferCompletionEnabled
362  NULL, //transferCompletionCallbackFxn
363  NULL, //transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg
364  NULL);
365 
366  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
367  {
368  goto exit;
369  }
370 
371  errorCode = DPEDMAHWA_configOneHotSignature(pRes->edmaHandle,
372  &pRes->edmaHwaInSignature,
373  hwaHandle,
374  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
375  false);
376 
377  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
378  {
379  goto exit;
380  }
381 
382 exit:
383  return(errorCode);
384 }

492 void CFARHWA_fovConvertDoppler(DPU_CFARProc_FovCfg *fovDopplerCfg,
493  float dopplerStep,
494  DPU_CFARProc_FovIdxCfg *fovDopplerIdxCfg)
495 {
496  float doppler;
497 
498  doppler = (fovDopplerCfg->min / dopplerStep);
499  if (doppler < 0.)
500  {
501  doppler -= .5;
502  }
503  else
504  {
505  doppler += .5;
506 
507  }
508  fovDopplerIdxCfg->minIdx = (int16_t) doppler;
509 
510  doppler = (fovDopplerCfg->max / dopplerStep);
511  if (doppler < 0.)
512  {
513  doppler -= .5;
514  }
515  else
516  {
517  doppler += .5;
518 
519  }
520  fovDopplerIdxCfg->maxIdx = (int16_t) doppler;
521 
522 }

571 int32_t CFARHWA_triggerCFAR(CFARHwaObj *cfarHwaObj, bool loadDataToHWA)
572 {
573  int32_t retVal = 0;
574  DPU_CFARProcHWA_HW_Resources *pRes = &cfarHwaObj->res;
575  uint32_t baseAddr, regionId;
576 
577  baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(pRes->edmaHandle);
578  DebugP_assert(baseAddr != 0U);
579 
580  regionId = EDMA_getRegionId(pRes->edmaHandle);
581  DebugP_assert(regionId < SOC_EDMA_NUM_REGIONS);
582 
583  /* Enable the HWA */
584  retVal = HWA_enable(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle, 1);
585  if (retVal != 0)
586  {
587  goto exit;
588  }
589  if (loadDataToHWA)
590  {
591  /* Trigger EDMA + CFAR Doppler */
592  (void)EDMA_enableTransferRegion(baseAddr, regionId, pRes->edmaHwaIn.channel, EDMA_TRIG_MODE_MANUAL);
593  }
594  else
595  {
596  /* Trigger CFAR Range only */
597  retVal = HWA_setDMA2ACCManualTrig(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
598  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx);
599  if (retVal != 0)
600  {
601  goto exit;
602  }
603  }
604 exit:
605  return retVal;
606 }

629 void CFARHWA_convHwaCfarDetListToDetMask(DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput *hwaCfarDetList,
630  uint32_t numDopBins,
631  uint32_t numCfarDetections,
632  uint32_t cfarDomain,
633  uint32_t *cfarDetOutBitMask)
634 {
635  uint32_t i;
636  uint32_t bit, word;
637  uint32_t temp;
638  uint32_t cellOffset;
639  uint32_t iterOffset;
640 
641  if (cfarDomain == DPU_CFAR_RANGE_DOMAIN)
642  {
643  /*CFAR in Range domain, cellIdx is range index, iterNum is Doppler index*/
644  cellOffset = numDopBins;
645  iterOffset = 1;
646  }
647  else
648  {
649  /*CFAR in Doppler domain, cellIdx is Doppler index, iterNum is Range index*/
650  cellOffset = 1;
651  iterOffset = numDopBins;
652  }
653 
654  for (i=0; i < numCfarDetections; i++)
655  {
656  temp = hwaCfarDetList[i].cellIdx * cellOffset + hwaCfarDetList[i].iterNum * iterOffset;
657  word = temp >> 5U;
658  bit = temp & 31U;
659  cfarDetOutBitMask[word] |= (uint32_t)1U << bit;
660  }
661 }
662 
684 bool CFARHWA_isHwaCfarDetected(uint32_t rangeInd,
685  uint32_t dopplerInd,
686  uint32_t numDopBins,
687  uint32_t *cfarDetOutBitMask)
688 {
689  uint32_t bit, word;
690  uint32_t temp;
691 
692  temp = rangeInd * numDopBins + dopplerInd;
693  word = temp >> 5U;
694  bit = temp & 31U;
695  if((cfarDetOutBitMask[word] & ((uint32_t)1U << bit)) != 0U)
696  {
697  return true;
698  }
699  else
700  {
701  return false;
702  }
703 }

739 uint32_t CFARHWA_cfarRange_AND_cfarDoppler(
740  DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput *cfarRangeDetOutList,
741  uint32_t numCfarRangeDet,
742  uint32_t *cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask,
743  DPIF_CFARDetList *cfarDetectionList,
744  uint32_t cfarDetectionListSize,
745  uint16_t *detMat,
746  uint16_t numDopplerBins,
747  uint16_t selRangeMin,
748  uint16_t selRangeMax,
749  int16_t selDopplerMin,
750  int16_t selDopplerMax,
751  bool andWithCfarDopplerOut
752  )
753 {
754  uint32_t numCfarDet;
755  uint32_t rangeIdx;
756  uint32_t dopplerIdx;
757  int32_t dopplerSgnIdx;
758  uint32_t i;
759  uint32_t cellLog2Noise;
760  bool addToList;
761  float snrdB, noisedB;
762 
763  numCfarDet = 0;
764  for (i=0; i < numCfarRangeDet; i++)
765  {
766  rangeIdx = cfarRangeDetOutList[i].cellIdx;
767  dopplerIdx = cfarRangeDetOutList[i].iterNum;
768  dopplerSgnIdx = (int32_t ) dopplerIdx;
769  if ((uint32_t)dopplerSgnIdx >= (numDopplerBins>>1U))
770  {
771  dopplerSgnIdx = dopplerSgnIdx - (int32_t)numDopplerBins;
772  }
773  cellLog2Noise = cfarRangeDetOutList[i].noise;
774  if ((rangeIdx >= selRangeMin) &&
775  (rangeIdx <= selRangeMax) &&
776  (dopplerSgnIdx >= selDopplerMin) &&
777  (dopplerSgnIdx <= selDopplerMax))
778  {
779  if (andWithCfarDopplerOut)
780  {
781  addToList = CFARHWA_isHwaCfarDetected(rangeIdx, dopplerIdx, numDopplerBins, cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask);
782  }
783  else
784  {
785  addToList = true;
786  }
787  if (addToList)
788  {
789  cfarDetectionList[numCfarDet].rangeIdx = (uint16_t)rangeIdx;
790  cfarDetectionList[numCfarDet].dopplerIdx = (uint16_t)dopplerIdx;
791  //noisedB = ((float) cellLog2NoiseQ9) * 6. /512.;
792  noisedB = CFARDSP_CONV_PEAK_TO_LOG((float)cellLog2Noise, DPIF_DETMATRIX_DATA_QFORMAT);
793  snrdB = CFARDSP_CONV_PEAK_TO_LOG((float) detMat[rangeIdx * numDopplerBins + dopplerIdx],DPIF_DETMATRIX_DATA_QFORMAT) - noisedB;
794  cfarDetectionList[numCfarDet].noise = (int16_t)noisedB;
795  cfarDetectionList[numCfarDet].snr = (int16_t)snrdB;
796  numCfarDet++;
797  if (numCfarDet >= cfarDetectionListSize)
798  {
799  break;
800  }
801  }
802  }
803  }
804  return numCfarDet;
805 }

807 DPU_CFARProcHWA_Handle DPU_CFARProcHWA_init
808 (
809  DPU_CFARProcHWA_InitParams *initCfg,
810  volatile uint8_t subframeCounter,
811  int32_t* errCode
812 )
813 {
814  CFARHwaObj *cfarHwaObj = NULL;
815  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
816  *errCode = 0;
817 
818  if ((initCfg == NULL) || (initCfg->hwaHandle == NULL))
819  {
820  *errCode = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
821  goto exit;
822  }
823 
824  DebugP_assert(subframeCounter < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES);
825 
826  /* Allocate Memory for rangeProc */
827  cfarHwaObj = (CFARHwaObj*)&cfarProcObjPool[subframeCounter];
828 
829  /* Save for debugging */
830 #ifdef DBG_CFAR_HWA_OBJ_DPU
831  if (gCfarHwaObjInd < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES)
832  {
833  gCfarHwaObj[gCfarHwaObjInd++] = cfarHwaObj;
834  }
835 #endif
836 
837  /* Initialize memory */
838  (void)memset((void *)cfarHwaObj, 0, sizeof(CFARHwaObj));
839 
840  /* Save init config params */
841  cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle = initCfg->hwaHandle;
842 
843  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&cfarHwaObj->hwaDone_semaHandle, 0);
844  DebugP_assert(SystemP_SUCCESS == status);
845 
846 exit:
847 
848  if(*errCode < 0)
849  {
850  /* Free the object if it was allocated */
851  if(cfarHwaObj != NULL)
852  {
853  cfarHwaObj = NULL;
854  }
855  }
856 
857  return ((DPU_CFARProcHWA_Handle)cfarHwaObj);

860 int32_t DPU_CFARProcHWA_config
861 (
862  DPU_CFARProcHWA_Handle handle,
863  DPU_CFARProcHWA_Config *cfarHwaCfg
864 )
865 {
866  int32_t retVal = 0;
867 
868  CFARHwaObj *cfarHwaObj = (CFARHwaObj *)handle;
869  DPU_CFARProcHWA_HW_Resources *pRes = &cfarHwaCfg->res;
870  DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig *staticCfg = &cfarHwaCfg->staticCfg;
871 
872  if(cfarHwaObj == NULL)
873  {
874  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
875  goto exit;
876  }
877 
878 
879  if(pRes->hwaCfg.numParamSet != DPU_CFARPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS)
880  {
881  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL__NUM_PARAM_SETS;
882  goto exit;
883  }
884 
885  /* Check if detection matrix format is supported. */
886  if(pRes->detMatrix.datafmt != DPIF_DETMATRIX_FORMAT_1)
887  {
888  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL__DET_MATRIX_FORMAT;
889  goto exit;
890  }
891 
892  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->detMatrix.data,
893  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_DET_MATRIX_BYTE_ALIGNMENT))
894  {
895  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEMALIGN_DET_MATRIX;
896  goto exit;
897  }
898 
899 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
900  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->cfarRngDopSnrList,
901  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_CFAR_DET_LIST_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F))
902 #else
903  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->cfarRngDopSnrList,
904  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_CFAR_DET_LIST_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP))
905 #endif
906  {
907  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEMALIGN_CFAR_DET_LIST;
908  goto exit;
909  }
910 
911  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->hwaMemOutDoppler,
912  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_HWA_MEM_OUT_DOPPLER_BYTE_ALIGNMENT))
913  {
914  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEMALIGN_HWA_MEM_OUT_DOPPLER;
915  goto exit;
916  }
917 
918  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->hwaMemOutRange,
919  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_HWA_MEM_OUT_RANGE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT))
920  {
921  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEMALIGN_HWA_MEM_OUT_RANGE;
922  goto exit;
923  }
924 
925 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
926  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask,
927  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_DOPPLER_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F))
928 #else
929  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask,
930  DPU_CFARPROCHWA_DOPPLER_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP))
931 #endif
932  {
933  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEMALIGN_DOPPLER_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK;
934  goto exit;
935  }
936 
937  /* check if input M scratch for detection matrix has
938  * entire detection matrix fitting in it */
939  if ((pRes->hwaMemInpSize * sizeof(uint16_t)) < pRes->detMatrix.dataSize)
940  {
941  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEM__DET_MATRIX_EXCEEDS_HWA_INP_MEM;
942  goto exit;
943  }
944 
945  /* check if input scratch memory for bit mask is sufficient */
946  if ((pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMaskSize * 32U) <
947  (staticCfg->numDopplerBins * staticCfg->numRangeBins))
948  {
949  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_ENOMEM__INSUFFICIENT_DOP_DET_OUT_BIT_MASK;
950  goto exit;
951  }
952 
953  CFARHWA_saveConfiguration(cfarHwaObj, cfarHwaCfg);
954 
955  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
956  {
957  /**************************************/
958  /* CFAR DOPPLER DOMAIN */
959  /**************************************/
960  retVal = HWAutil_configCFAR(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
961  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
962  staticCfg->numRangeBins,
963  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
964  &cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler,
965  (uint16_t)pRes->hwaMemOutDopplerSize,
966  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx, /* triggerSrc */
967  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemInp),
968  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemOutDoppler),
969  DPU_CFAR_DOPPLER_DOMAIN);
970  if (retVal != 0)
971  {
972  goto exit;
973  }
974  }
975 
976  /**************************************/
977  /* CFAR RANGE DOMAIN */
978  /**************************************/
979  retVal = HWAutil_configCFAR(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
980  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx + 1U,
981  staticCfg->numRangeBins,
982  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
983  &cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgRange,
984  (uint16_t)pRes->hwaMemOutRangeSize,
985  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx, /* triggerSrc */
986  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemInp),
987  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemOutRange),
988  DPU_CFAR_RANGE_DOMAIN);
989  if (retVal != 0)
990  {
991  goto exit;
992  }
993 
994  /* Configure EDMA */
995  retVal = CFARHWA_config_EDMA(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle, pRes, staticCfg);
996  if (retVal != 0)
997  {
998  goto exit;
999  }
1000 
1001 exit:
1002  return retVal;
1003 }

1005 int32_t DPU_CFARProcHWA_process
1006 (
1007  DPU_CFARProcHWA_Handle handle,
1008  DPU_CFARProcHWA_OutParams *outParams
1009 )
1010 {
1011  volatile uint64_t startTime;
1012  volatile uint64_t startTime1;
1013  uint16_t numObjs = 0;
1014  uint32_t cfarDomain;
1015  bool loadDataToHWA;
1016  bool andWithCfarDopplerOut;
1017  int32_t retVal = 0;
1018  uint64_t waitTimeLocal = 0;
1019 
1020  CFARHwaObj *cfarHwaObj;
1021  DPU_CFARProcHWA_HW_Resources *pRes;
1022  DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig *staticCfg;
1023 
1024  if (handle == NULL)
1025  {
1026  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1027  goto exit;
1028  }
1029 
1030  cfarHwaObj = (CFARHwaObj *)handle;
1031  pRes = &cfarHwaObj->res;
1032  staticCfg = &cfarHwaObj->staticCfg;
1033 
1034  startTime = ClockP_getTimeUsec();
1035 
1036  /**********************************************/
1037  /* ENABLE NUMLOOPS DONE INTERRUPT FROM HWA */
1038  /**********************************************/
1039  retVal = HWA_enableDoneInterrupt(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
1040  0, //thread 0
1041  CFARHWADoneIsrCallback,
1042  (void *)&cfarHwaObj->hwaDone_semaHandle);
1043  if (retVal != 0)
1044  {
1045  goto exit;
1046  }
1047  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
1048  {
1049  cfarDomain = DPU_CFAR_DOPPLER_DOMAIN;
1050  retVal = CFARHWA_prepareHwaRunTime (cfarHwaObj, cfarDomain);
1051  if (retVal != 0)
1052  {
1053  goto exit;
1054  }
1055 
1056  /* Trigger CFAR */
1057  loadDataToHWA = true;
1058  retVal = CFARHWA_triggerCFAR(cfarHwaObj, loadDataToHWA);
1059  if (retVal != 0)
1060  {
1061  goto exit;
1062  }
1063 
1064  /* In parallel with HWA zero cfarDetOutBitMask while HWA doing CFAR */
1065  (void)memset (pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask, 0x0, pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMaskSize * sizeof(uint32_t));
1066 
1067  /* wait for the paramSets done interrupt */
1068  startTime1 = ClockP_getTimeUsec();
1069  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&cfarHwaObj->hwaDone_semaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1070  waitTimeLocal += ClockP_getTimeUsec() - startTime1;
1071 
1072  (void)HWA_readCFARPeakCountReg(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t *) &cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint16_t));
1073  if (cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs > cfarHwaObj->res.hwaMemOutDopplerSize)
1074  {
1075  cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs = (uint16_t)cfarHwaObj->res.hwaMemOutDopplerSize;
1076  }
1077  }
1078 
1079  /* Do CFAR Range */
1080  /* Prepare Common Reg and CFAR threshold */
1081  cfarDomain = DPU_CFAR_RANGE_DOMAIN;
1082  retVal = CFARHWA_prepareHwaRunTime (cfarHwaObj, cfarDomain);
1083  if (retVal != 0)
1084  {
1085  goto exit;
1086  }
1087 
1088  /* Trigger CFAR Range */
1089  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
1090  {
1091  loadDataToHWA = false;
1092  }
1093  else
1094  {
1095  loadDataToHWA = true;
1096  }
1097  retVal = CFARHWA_triggerCFAR(cfarHwaObj, loadDataToHWA);
1098  if (retVal != 0)
1099  {
1100  goto exit;
1101  }
1102 
1103  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
1104  {
1105  /* In parallel with HWA convert Doppler CFAR output list into bit mask */
1106  CFARHWA_convHwaCfarDetListToDetMask((DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput * ) pRes->hwaMemOutDoppler,
1107  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
1108  cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs,
1109  DPU_CFAR_DOPPLER_DOMAIN,
1110  pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask);
1111  }
1112 
1113  /* wait for the paramSets done interrupt */
1114  startTime1 = ClockP_getTimeUsec();
1115  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&cfarHwaObj->hwaDone_semaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1116  waitTimeLocal += ClockP_getTimeUsec() - startTime1;
1117 
1118  (void)HWA_readCFARPeakCountReg(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
1119  (uint8_t *) &cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs,
1120  (uint8_t)sizeof(uint16_t));
1121  if (cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs > cfarHwaObj->res.hwaMemOutRangeSize)
1122  {
1123  cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs = (uint16_t)cfarHwaObj->res.hwaMemOutRangeSize;
1124  }
1125 
1126  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
1127  {
1128  andWithCfarDopplerOut = true;
1129  }
1130  else
1131  {
1132  andWithCfarDopplerOut = false;
1133  }
1134 
1135  cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs = (uint16_t)CFARHWA_cfarRange_AND_cfarDoppler(
1136  (DPU_CFARProcHWA_CfarDetOutput * ) pRes->hwaMemOutRange,
1137  cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs,
1138  pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask,
1139  pRes->cfarRngDopSnrList,
1140  pRes->cfarRngDopSnrListSize,
1141  pRes->detMatrix.data,
1142  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
1143  (uint16_t)cfarHwaObj->fovRange.minIdx,
1144  (uint16_t)cfarHwaObj->fovRange.maxIdx,
1145  cfarHwaObj->fovDoppler.minIdx,
1146  cfarHwaObj->fovDoppler.maxIdx,
1147  andWithCfarDopplerOut);
1148 
1149  numObjs = cfarHwaObj->numHwaCfarObjs;
1150  cfarHwaObj->numProcess++;
1151 
1152  /* Disable the HWA */
1153  retVal = HWA_enable(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle, 0);
1154  if (retVal != 0)
1155  {
1156  outParams->numCfarDetectedPoints = 0U;
1157  goto exit;
1158  }
1159 
1160 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
1161  /* write back output buffer cfar list as per DPU design rules */
1162  CacheP_wb(pRes->cfarRngDopSnrList, pRes->cfarRngDopSnrListSize, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1163 
1164  /* invalidate bit mask (scratch buffer) if used as per DPU design rules */
1165  if (cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale > 0U)
1166  {
1167  CacheP_inv(pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMask, pRes->cfarDopplerDetOutBitMaskSize, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1168  }
1169 #endif
1170 
1171  outParams->numCfarDetectedPoints = numObjs;
1172  (void)HWA_disableDoneInterrupt(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle, 0);
1173  outParams->stats.waitTime = waitTimeLocal;
1174  outParams->stats.processingTime = ClockP_getTimeUsec() - startTime - waitTimeLocal;
1175  outParams->stats.numProcess = cfarHwaObj->numProcess;
1176 exit:
1177  return (retVal);
1178 }
1179

1181 (
1182  DPU_CFARProcHWA_Handle handle,
1183  DPU_CFARProcHWA_Cmd cmd,
1184  void *arg,
1185  uint32_t argSize
1186 )

1188  int32_t retVal = 0;

1215  /**************************************/

1220  staticCfg->numRangeBins,
1221  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
1222  &cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgRange,
1223  (uint16_t)pRes->hwaMemOutRangeSize,
1224  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx, /* triggerSrc */
1225  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemInp),
1226  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemOutRange),
1227  DPU_CFAR_RANGE_DOMAIN);
1228  if (retVal != 0)
1229  {
1230  goto exit;
1231  }
1232  }
1233  }
1234  break;
1235  case DPU_CFARProcHWA_Cmd_CfarDopplerCfg:
1236  {
1237  if((argSize != sizeof(DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg)) ||
1238  (arg == NULL))
1239  {
1240  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1241  goto exit;
1242  }
1243  else
1244  {
1245  /* Save configuration */
1246  (void)memcpy((void *)&cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler, arg, argSize);
1247 
1248  /**************************************/
1249  /* CFAR DOPPLER DOMAIN */
1250  /**************************************/
1251  retVal = HWAutil_configCFAR(cfarHwaObj->hwaHandle,
1252  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx, //Doppler position
1253  staticCfg->numRangeBins,
1254  staticCfg->numDopplerBins,
1255  &cfarHwaObj->cfarCfgDoppler,
1256  (uint16_t)pRes->hwaMemOutDopplerSize,
1257  pRes->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx, /* triggerSrc */
1258  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemInp),
1259  HWADRV_ADDR_TRANSLATE_CPU_TO_HWA(pRes->hwaMemOutDoppler),
1260  DPU_CFAR_DOPPLER_DOMAIN);
1261  if (retVal != 0)
1262  {
1263  goto exit;
1264  }
1265  }
1266  }
1267  break;
1268  case DPU_CFARProcHWA_Cmd_FovRangeCfg:
1269  {
1270  if((argSize != sizeof(DPU_CFARProc_FovCfg)) ||
1271  (arg == NULL))
1272  {
1273  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1274  goto exit;
1275  }
1276  else
1277  {
1278  /* Save configuration */
1279  CFARHWA_fovConvertRange(arg,
1280  cfarHwaObj->staticCfg.rangeStep,
1281  &cfarHwaObj->fovRange);
1282  }
1283  }
1284  break;
1285  case DPU_CFARProcHWA_Cmd_FovDopplerCfg:
1286  {
1287  if((argSize != sizeof(DPU_CFARProc_FovCfg)) ||
1288  (arg == NULL))
1289  {
1290  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1291  goto exit;
1292  }
1293  else
1294  {
1295  /* Save configuration */
1296  CFARHWA_fovConvertDoppler(arg,
1297  cfarHwaObj->staticCfg.dopplerStep,
1298  &cfarHwaObj->fovDoppler);
1299  }
1300  }
1301  break;
1302  default:
1303  retVal = DPU_CFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1304  break;
1305  }
1306 exit:
1307  return (retVal);
1308 }
